name: Gabiano

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for red wine, limited to the hillside vineyards of Gabiano and Moncestino in Alessandria province. It is 90 to 95% Barbera, with Freisa, Grignolino, Nebbiolo or Dolcetto making up the rest.
